questions.question: What is the opening declaration of Psalm 93?
options: The kingdom has fallen and the king is dead
The LORD has forsaken his holy city
A famine spreads across the whole land
The LORD reigns; he is robed in majesty
questions.answer: The LORD reigns; he is robed in majesty

questions.question: What is said about God's throne?
options: It is hidden from the wise, but revealed to the simple
It is established from of old; he is from everlasting
It is fragile and passing, like the morning dew
It is feared by the nations, mocked by the proud
questions.answer: It is established from of old; he is from everlasting

questions.question: The psalm says the floods have lifted up their voice, but the LORD on high is mightier.
The LORD _____; he is robed in majesty.
Your decrees are very trustworthy; _____ befits your house, O LORD, forevermore.
